hook.name: SimpleBurnRewardHook
hook.description: A combined ERC-20 token and Uniswap v4 hook. On buy swaps (ETH→token), burns a configurable percentage of the token output from the user's proceeds, reducing total supply. On sell swaps (token→ETH), collects a configurable portion of ETH output into a reward pool distributed proportionally to token holders via a MasterChef-style accumulator; holders claim ETH rewards via claimReward().
